ns2:course.label: Real Estate Development
ns2:course.description: Discusses key steps in the real estate development process, from market feasibility analysis to financing, legal issues, construction and asset management. Current issues in real estate development will also be presented by guest lecturers who are senior industry executives. 4 graduate hours. No professional credit. Prerequisite: FIN 541 recommended but not required. Restricted to graduate students only.
